scope: Native flat Parquet adapter and full ClickBench evidence; broader P2–P6 roadmap remains partial

scalar_decoder.method: Recompile src/io/parquet.c with -U__SSE2__ and ASan/UBSan; link against sanitized library/test objects; run -f parquet

fuzz.command: setarch x86_64 -R env ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1 build_fuzz/fuzz_parquet fuzz/corpus/parquet fuzz/seeds/parquet -rss_limit_mb=4096 -timeout=10 -max_len=16384 -print_final_stats=1 -artifact_prefix=build/parquet-recovery/fuzz/ -max_total_time=600
setup_notes: Initial Clang link needed the installed GCC 11 C++ library search path.
Initial startup segfaulted before processing input; an empty-input replay passed, and the sustained run used the existing reduced-ASLR workaround.
No ASan, UBSan or LSan diagnostics appeared in the successful full-run log.
fuzz.limits: Serial decoder/pruning harness, at most 256 batches of 257 rows per input; does not cover parallel scheduling or native publication.
